subject: Audit log extract: regional slices, formats, and deletion assurances
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finvero.com>
To: Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finvero.com
Date: 2028-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit log extract: regional slices and deletion proof

Hi Grace,

Quick question following our compliance review: Finvero needs an export of access and audit logs for a subset of EU tenants for the period 2027-08-01 to 2027-12-31. The requirements are:
- A region-scoped extract (EU only) with preserved event timestamps
- Deliverable formats: NDJSON for events and a manifest CSV describing file chunking
- A certified proof of deletion for any retained copies after handoff

Can Redwood provide:
1) Confirmation that exports can be limited to EU residency slices without including cross-region metadata;
2) The typical SLA for generating an export of ~120GB of compressed logs;
3) The deletion attestation we can include in our regulator packet (what form does that take?).

Also cc'd our security mailbox in case there are additional evidence requirements.

Thanks,
Alex
Security Engineering
Finvero

--
Attachment: sample_manifest_request.csv (CSV)
From: Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finvero.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log extract: regional slices and deletion proof

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, with details below:

1) Yes — we can generate region-scoped exports that include only EU-resident tenant traces and omit cross-region telemetry fields by default.
2) SLA: typical turnaround is 3-5 business days for a 100–200GB job; we can expedite to 24–48 hours for an elevated request (expedite fee applies).
3) Deletion attestation: we provide a signed manifest that lists delivered files, the SHA256 checksums, and a post-handoff erase confirmation with the timestamp and job ID. For regulated customers we can also include an HSM-signed attestation.

Details and constraints:
- Format: we will deliver NDJSON event files + a manifest CSV (we can follow your sample). See attached export_schema.csv for field mapping and chunking conventions.
- Cross-region metadata: by default we redact any internal routing/replication fields that could indicate non-EU hosts; if you need raw routing fields we'll need explicit consent and a data transfer assessment.
- Retention/deletion: our handoff playbook stage (job state: COMPLETED -> HANDOFF -> ERASURE) will time-stamp the moment we remove temporary export artifacts from our intermediate staging tier.
- Proof: two artifacts provided — (A) export_manifest.csv (file list + sizes + checksums + export_job_id), (B) erase_certificate.txt (signed by Redwood key with erase_job_id and timestamp).

I'll loop in Marissa (operations) and Karthik (legal/compliance) to confirm expedite options and the HSM-signed attestation.

Best,
Grace
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: export_schema.csv (CSV)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finvero.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-19T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log extract: regional slices and deletion proof

Alex — operational notes from the export team:

- Job sizing: 120GB compressed is within our standard bulk export pipeline. We will chunk at ~10GB compressed per object and provide the manifest referencing each object (see egress_manifest_v1.pdf for sample manifest layout).
- Turnaround: we can do 72 hours standard. If Finvero signs the expedited playbook (we'll send a DocuSign), we can aim for 36 hours. Please note that expedited jobs bypass some low-priority queueing but will still respect tenant rate limits.
- Data residency: we will run the extraction from our EU region-only read replicas. The exported objects are staged in an EU-only S3 bucket and transferred using pre-signed URLs to your drop-off location (you can provide an S3 endpoint or an SFTP host).
- Deletion: after successful transfer and verification of checksums, our staging objects are scheduled for immediate deletion and a background erase job runs to truncate temporary indices. The erase_certificate.txt contains the erase_job_id and a signed timestamp.

Action items for Finvero: please confirm the drop-off mechanism (pre-signed S3 or SFTP), and whether you require HSM-signed attestation. Once confirmed we will open ticket EX-9421 and provide a firm ETA.

Marissa
Export Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finvero.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finvero.com
Date: 2028-09-19T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log extract: regional slices and deletion proof

Thanks Grace / Marissa — that covers most of it. A couple follow ups:

- We'll take pre-signed S3 drop-off to our EU S3 bucket (details to follow in a secure note).
- For regulatory packaging, we need the HSM-signed attestation. Can you confirm any lead time or additional redaction needed to produce HSM-signed erase_certificate.txt?
- Also: does your manifest include per-event sequence numbers or just per-file checksums? Our auditors ask for event continuity markers.

If you can provide these, I'll open the compliance request and we can sign the expedite DocuSign.

—Alex
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finvero.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log extract: regional slices and deletion proof

Alex — quick confirmation from legal/compliance: HSM-signed attestations are available but require a short approval flow (typically same-business-day if we receive the signed SOP acceptance). No additional redaction is required for the attestation — it certifies the erase job and references the export_job_id and file checksums.

Regarding event continuity: our manifest includes a per-event sequence token for streams generated by the runtime (field: event_sequence_id). For historic files extracted from blob stores we include per-event offsets in the NDJSON payload and the per-file first/last event_sequence_id in the manifest so you can reconstruct ordering.

I'll authorize expedited handling once we see the DocuSign and your drop-off endpoint. Grace/Marissa — please prepare EX-9421 with expedite option and HSM attestation add-on.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
